name: Add the Attachments Built-in Plugin: storage, CLI and doctor
description:
Part of the Epic `clipboard-image-attachments`; read its description first. It needs binary Plugin files and the clipboard reader from the Stories that block it.

## Goal

A new **Attachments** Built-in Plugin that stores image files on Stories, with CLI commands and doctor checks. The TUI and pasting are a separate Story.

## Data

- Files: `boards/<b>/stories/<KEY>/plugins/attachments/<id>.png`, saved as binary Plugin files.
- A bag on the Story lists them, in order: `{ id, name, type, size, createdAt, createdBy }`. `createdBy` is Me, or `null`.
- Default names for pasted images: `image-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.png`. A file added from a path keeps its base name.
- The operation `attachments.add` writes the file and the bag entry together; `attachments.remove` deletes both.

## CLI

Every data change must be a command as well as a key; this also covers SSH.

- `rowbly attachment add <KEY> <file>` and `rowbly attachment add <KEY> --from-clipboard` (uses the clipboard reader).
- `rowbly attachment list <KEY> [--json]`
- `rowbly attachment remove <KEY> <id>`: destructive, so it needs `--yes` when it can't prompt.
- `rowbly attachment open <KEY> <id>`: opens the file with `open`, `start` or `xdg-open`. Plugins have no filesystem or process capability, so add a small Plugin API helper.

Check the noun with the glossary: `attachment` or `attachments`, matching how other Plugins name their commands (e.g. `comments`).

## Doctor

- Report a file with no bag entry, and a bag entry with no file.
- `--fix` repairs what is safe.
- A Story renumbered by doctor already takes its Plugin files with it; check that it does for these files.

## Built-in Plugin checklist (`docs/plugins/writing-a-plugin.md` §12)

- `src/plugins/attachments/` with `index.ts` and `definePlugin`; an entry in `builtInPlugins`; the TUI part loaded lazily.
- `src/plugins/attachments/CONTEXT.md` defining **Attachment**, with an `_Avoid_` line (e.g. upload, file blob). Link it from `docs/agents/CONTEXT-MAP.md`.
- Its section in `docs/plugins/built-in.md`.
- Its operations in `docs/architecture/operations.md`. `test/plugins/operationInventory.test.ts` parses those tables, so keep their headings and row format.
- `docs/user-guide.md`: the commands and doctor findings.
- `skills/rowbly/references/plugin-attachments.md` and a row in `skills/rowbly/SKILL.md`. Update `skills/rowbly-reference.md`, then copy it to `.agents/skills/rowbly-dev/references/rowbly-reference.md`.
- Imports only from `../../plugin-api` and `../../plugin-api/tui`.

## Tests

None by default (AGENTS.md). Check it by running `pnpm dev attachment …` against a scratch Data Root, and say how in the pull request.

## Done when

`pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test:unit` and `pnpm test:cli` all pass.
